name: marginer
description: Highlight any page, add notes and emoji, export the lot as markdown. Extension, userscript, or bookmarklet.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/csp.mjs && node test/userscript.mjs && node test/extension.mjs && node test/threads.mjs
